purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (shinryo) system - monthly billing processing; specifically a batch report for counting specified medical treatment (shinryo koi) occurrences by patient
purpose.summary: ORCBG016 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that queries indexed files of medical treatment records and accounting data to produce a count report of specified medical treatment acts (shitei shinryo koi kensu-cho). It reads patient treatment history and accounting files, aggregates counts by treatment code and department, and outputs results via the ORCA print subsystem.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM parsed via UNSTRING
INDEXED file organization with DYNAMIC access
grpsys conditional compilation markers for group/system variants
OCCURS clauses for daily totals (31 days) and patient arrays (1000)
19 CALL statements to ORCA subsystem routines (ORCSJOB, etc.)
Japanese comments encoded in Latin-1 (actually EUC-JP or Shift-JIS)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCA DB access layer
verdict.notes: Source comments are Japanese encoded as Latin-1 in the archive but are likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS; characters appear garbled in Latin-1 decoding. The 'grpsys' prefix on some lines appears to be a conditional compilation or variant-selection mechanism specific to the ORCA build system.
